subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — UI dashboard and CLI command

question: Should OpenClaw core ship this AI-safety taxonomy and a permanent top-level CLI/Control UI observability surface, or should the work remain deferred or plugin-owned?
rationale: The PR creates a new public diagnostic schema, plugin SDK surface, Gateway API, CLI command, navigation destination, storage owner, and privacy contract; code review cannot choose those permanent product boundaries.

options.title: Sequence a core implementation
options.body: Approve the core direction, land the prerequisite contracts first, then require a rebased SQLite-backed and protocol-complete implementation before merging the UI/CLI surface.

options.title: Narrow the core surface
options.body: Keep only a generic diagnostic event and query seam in core, with specialized safety taxonomy, exporters, and dashboards supplied by a diagnostics plugin.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause or close the stacked PRs until a maintainer-sponsored safety observability milestone defines taxonomy ownership, retention, privacy, and operator UX.

recommendation.title: Sequence a core implementation
recommendation.body: Approve the core direction, land the prerequisite contracts first, then require a rebased SQLite-backed and protocol-complete implementation before merging the UI/CLI surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Telemetry and security ownership most directly spans the taxonomy, privacy model, and exporter contract that must be decided first.
